messages:
Taylor Nguyen: dropping a new variant of the playground interaction 0—compacted stream controls inside the composer toolbar: single collapsed widget that expands on hover/focus to show Interrupt + Regenerate + token pill. goal: fewer overlays and clearer mobile fallback. feedback?
Sofia Morales: neat. for mobile, can that expand upward so it doesn't cover composer actions? otherwise users lose send/regenerate placement.
Ibrahim Khan: technical: expand on focus is fine, but we must ensure the expand animation respects prefers-reduced-motion. also keep the expand area reachable via keyboard (tab) and not just hover.
Renee Park: a11y checklist: icon-only collapsed state needs aria-labels, and the expanded panel should set aria-modal=false but trap focus to the panel controls while open. add aria-live polite updates for final state messages only.
Taylor Nguyen: copy thought: instead of "Stop" let's use "Interrupt streaming" in the expanded view label; collapsed tooltip shows shortened text. regenerate hover text: "Regenerate response (Ctrl+.)".
Sofia Morales: token pill: show live approximate like "~80 tok" while streaming, exact on finish. avoid spamming screen readers—announce only after completion: "Response complete: 80 tokens".
Ibrahim Khan: batching plan: UI updates every 700ms, server telemetry every 5s. debounce regenerate by 350ms. on regen mid-stream: abort + start new generation, with a tiny queued state indicator.
Renee Park: color contrast: collapsed widget background must hit 4.5:1 with the icon. add a visible 3px focus ring that uses the high-contrast token. also expose the keyboard shortcut in the help overlay.
Taylor Nguyen: prompt library tie-in: show a small "est. tok" badge on prompts and when a prompt with variables is selected show a pre-run estimate and a quick "Run with estimate" CTA. keep phrasing compact: "Est. 34 tok".
Sofia Morales: microcopy variants: "Interrupt streaming" vs "Pause streaming". I prefer Interrupt because it's clearer that it ends the current output but preserves the draft. add help text to explain differences.
Ibrahim Khan: implementation note: pausing should not clear KV cache; interrupt + regen should reset generation state but preserve context. we'll keep session tokens intact.
Renee Park: I'll run the prototype with VoiceOver and NVDA once it's up. please include a short accessibility notes panel in the figma so I can verify.
CLI-Bot: figma: mock updated by Taylor Nguyen at 1769135855 — https://www.figma.com/file/xyz/playground-compact-controls
Taylor Nguyen: thanks all 44d I'll iterate on the mock and post a short recording of keyboard flows. ping if anything missing.
